gaps.detail: The CPU contribution is 1.239991595 (R/G) and 1.176608276 (B); the observed FP16 delta is 1.2392578125 (R/G) and 1.1767578125 (B). The unrounded residual is +0.7514 ULP (R/G) and -0.1531 ULP (B), within the 1-ULP tolerance. The predicted FP16 codeword is +1 ULP in R/G and exact in B. The LTC sidecar is actual and bit-identical to the quantized LTC.h, so this is not an LTC-content gap. No missing operand has been identified; the remaining sub-ULP difference is in the GPU shader evaluation (candidates include the half-precision BxDF inputs and filter/approximation details), which this float64 CPU replay does not model bit-exactly.

Only the final quantized 4-bit MaskBits is replayed. The SMRT/VSM producer (pass 248) is not replayed; page table, page flags, page receiver masks, physical page pool, projection data, light grid and culled-light grid are retained as operands but not sampled. Visibility=1.0 is exact for the 15/15 codeword; the unquantized shadow factor is not independently proven.
No compiled PSO/shader hash was captured for pass 249. The active permutation is derived from the captured parameters/CVars and source; a byte-exact compiled shader identity remains open (old M8).

Sampler bindings are pointer-only (StateCaptured=false). The LTC sampler pointer equals View.SharedBilinearClampedSampler and source initializes that object as SF_Bilinear/AM_Clamp x3, so bilinear-clamp is the correct interpretation; the raw sampler object state was not captured.

The LTC native bindings are ReusedScheduledReadback from pass 000100000225fb9fef70 with TimingRisk=OwnerPassNotExecutedAtCPUCollection; the exported file exists, size matches, DumpReadbackStatus=Dumped, and its 64x64 half values are bit-identical to the quantized LTC.h. The content is therefore valid for this static global LUT, but the capture-side timing caveat is retained.

SubresourceLayouts marks the LTC exports StoredBytesAreNativeStorage=false, NativeValueInterpretation=DecodedFloat, BitExact=false, ValuePreserving=true. The decoder follows StoredFormat (PF_FloatRGBA / PF_G16R16F) and preserves file channel order; it does not assume a half2/half4 decoder from NativeFormat.
